title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: The last play
hook: One play left. Who gets the ball?
intro: Everyone knows who the best player is.
statement: The last play teaches the whole team something.
q1: Do you go to your best player —
q2: or give the moment to someone who has not had one?
q3: What will the team remember about this play?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids grow
t2: when they get trusted in big moments.
cta: Coaches — who gets the last shot?
ctaLines: Best player. The open player. Whoever earns it.
Go with the best or share the moment?
ctaPrompt: Share your game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
One play left. Who gets the ball?
The game is tied. Everyone knows who the best player is.
The last play teaches the whole team something.
Go to your best player or share the moment. Every team is different.
Who gets the last shot? Share your habit in the comments.
